# Navigation-Only Map — BOOK-013
**Source:** CIDOB political biography | Andrés Manuel López Obrador
**Locator:** `extracted HTML block 1` through `extracted HTML block 67`
**Note:** This map is navigation only. It identifies where topics, actors, and periods appear in the document. It does not treat any content as evidence for the 5B questions.

---

## Document Overview

The source is a chronological political biography organized into **ten numbered sections** (declared in unit-0007 and reflected throughout). The biography covers López Obrador's life from birth (1953) through his 2018 presidential victory. A final update note in block 1 records the end of his presidency (1 October 2024) and successor Claudia Sheinbaum.

Coverage of the **2018–2024 presidential term** is limited: the bulk of the biography was published 29 November 2018 and describes the political career leading up to inauguration. Only a brief framing passage (block 1, block 6) sketches the early post-inauguration period.

## Methodology ID Cross-Reference (5B.1–5B.10)

> The biography is a **political biography**, not an economic governance evaluation. It contains **no direct evidence** for any 5B question. The map below identifies where **relevantly adjacent** content appears — but every 5B question requires additional independent evidence.

| 5B Question | Adjacent content in source | Locator blocks |
|---|---|---|
| **5B.1** — Legislative agenda, budgets, rents vs. prosperity | General references to "austeridad republicana," social spending orientation, anti-neoliberal discourse; no execution data | 5, 6, 62–63 |
| **5B.2** — Appoint qualified economic professionals, operational independence | No evidence on appointments or operational independence of economic technocrats | — |
| **5B.3** — Fiscal, tax, debt, monetary rules, macroeconomic stability | Broad description of free-market pragmatic stance (unit 6, 63) but no evidence on enacted rules or compliance | 6, 63 |
| **5B.4** — Fair laws for competition, entrepreneurship, property, trade | No direct evidence | — |
| **5B.5** — Anti-corruption enforcement, audits, procurement | Broad anti-corruption pledges; no enforcement evidence | 5, 6, 30, 38, 47, 63 |
| **5B.6** — Budget outcomes: infrastructure, education, health, administration | DF social programs (Pensión Alimenticia, infrastructure); no outcome metrics | 21 |
| **5B.7** — Reliable economic information, independent evaluation | General claims of transparency orientation in DF government; no documentation | 19, 21 |
| **5B.8** — Tax, labor, wage, benefit, regional policy fairness | "Primero los pobres" / redistribution orientation described; no incidence data | 5, 31, 48, 62 |
| **5B.9** — Shock response: inflation, unemployment, debt, sanctions | No direct evidence | — |
| **5B.10** — Durable economic trajectory vs. inherited | No comparative economic trajectory analysis | — |

**Overall 5B relevance:** Low to None. This source provides biographical and political context (career trajectory, stated policy orientations, electoral history) but **does not contain** the execution evidence, budget data, institutional behavior, or outcome metrics required by any 5B question. A separate evidence stream is required.
